linkedin.justification: The post captures core anthropological themes well but fails to include the required 3-5 hashtags.

flyer.justification: Adheres strictly to all constraints, including the 6-word title maximum and appropriate TBA placeholders.

instagram.justification: Meets all structural requirements, including visual carousel cues, emoji styling, and 11 targeted hashtags.

newsletter.justification: Well-crafted newsletter adhering to the character limit on the subject line, three-section structure with bold subheadings, and engaging editorial tone.

summary.justification: Concise executive briefing formatted properly under the 400-word limit with all required sections.

blog.justification: Structured effectively with numbered sections, comparison table, conclusion, and author profile details.
